subject: Error in lavPredict (number of items to replace)

messages.author: 3ad2e3c8753ce3ec
messages.subject: Error in lavPredict (number of items to replace)
parts:
Hi all,

I seem to be getting this error when trying to "extract" the latent scores:

library(lavaan)

adhd_home_env <- read.csv("adhd_home_env.csv")

mod_meas <- '
  ## latent variable definitions (CFA)
  # The "=~" can be read as "is identified by"
  HOME_t1 =~ accept_t1 + variety_t1 + acStim_t1
  HOME_t2 =~ accept_t2 + variety_t2 + acStim_t2
  
  ## covariances
  HOME_t1 ~~ HOME_t2 + adhd_t1 + adhd_t2
  HOME_t2 ~~ adhd_t1 + adhd_t2
  adhd_t1 ~~ adhd_t2
'

fit_meas <- cfa(mod_meas, data = adhd_home_env)

lavPredict(fit_meas)
#> Error in LAMBDA[ov.y.dummy.ov.idx, ] <- MLIST$beta[ov.y.dummy.lv.idx,  : 
#>   number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

(I know the model fits poorly, but this is for a teaching exercise...)

Any help would be appreciated...
